paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: The bar chart compares the accuracy performance of three audio-language models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on two benchmarks: MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three models in left-to-right order. For each model, two adjacent bars are shown: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR, as indicated in the legend. The accuracy values are approximately as follows: for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, MMAU is around 50% and MMAR is around 30%; for Audio-Reasoner, MMAU is approximately 62% and MMAR is around 38%; for Qwen-2.5-Omni, MMAU is about 65% and MMAR is around 55%. Across all models, the blue bars (MMAU) are consistently taller than the purple bars (MMAR), indicating higher accuracy on MMAU compared to MMAR. The bars are not sorted by performance but by model name, and no special visual emphasis (e.g., shading or annotations) is applied to any bar.
